results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Contractor expenses
results.text: Contractors may claim travel costs only when pre-approved in writing by their manager. No other expenses are reimbursable for contractors.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Home-office equipment
results.text: Home-office equipment up to $300 per year is reimbursable for full-time employees. This includes chairs, desks and monitors.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Contractor leave
results.text: Contractors are not eligible for paid leave, sick leave or parental leave under this policy. Their time away is governed by their contract.
